feeding_claim.verbatim: They are pasture raised and grain finished.

resold_note: Also sells pork from a neighboring Daviess County farm, plus milk, cheese and other products from partner producers.
notes: Gilles family farm with an on-farm market store in Owensboro, open Monday to Friday 10am to 6pm and Saturday 9am to 3pm. Read homepage, about, our products, online store and contact pages (WebFetch summaries, Verifier should recheck the quote). Products page says the beef gets grass or hay plus a daily grain ration, so grain-finished. Beef, broilers (March to October) and layer hens are raised on the farm. Online store says call for pickup or shipping options, with no shipping area stated, so no shipping channel recorded. Individual cuts only in store or at the Owensboro Farmers Market. No quarter or half beef mentioned. The Square store itself was not read.
